text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian suffers a minor injury during
practice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: Do you want to keep practicing?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: Do you want to keep practicing?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: Come on, let's get that properly treated.
Come on, let's treat that properly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her training cut short, Narita Brian
can't hide
her disappointment.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I can start again in just a second.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
All something like this needs to heal is a
bit of
spit and—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Damn. And I'm already short on time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: This is no time for resting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian tries to continue despite her
injury,
but I gently convince her to pause
her training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I was never planning on
stopping.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: Then at least let me patch you up.
Then at least let me patch you up, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
But as soon as you're done wrapping me
up, I'm
running. Got it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems the proper treatment helped.
She
continues training after with no
issue.
